_>     def is_connected(self):
>         return self._probe() is not None

e>     def get_block(self, block_hash):
>         net = self._probe()
>         if net is None:
>             raise NotConnected('Not connected to the Bitcoin network')
>         if net == 'rpc':
>             try:
>                 return self._block_via_rpc(block_hash)
>             except ValueError:
>                 raise NotFound('Block not found')
>         try:
>             return self._block_via_public(block_hash)
>         except NotFound:
>             raise
>         except requests.RequestException as e:
>             if getattr(e, 'response', None) and e.response.status_code == 404:
>                 raise NotFound('Block not found')
>             raise

>     def _tx_via_rpc(self, txid):
>         t = self.rpc.call('getrawtransaction', [txid, 1, None])
>         vin = []
>         for inp in t.get('vin', []):
>             vin.append({'coinbase': inp.get('coinbase', ''), 'sequence': inp.get('sequence', 0)})
>         vout = []
>         for i, out in enumerate(t.get('vout', [])):
>             spk = out.get('scriptPubKey', {})
>             vout.append({
>                 'value': out.get('value', 0),
>                 'n': out.get('n', i),
>                 'scriptPubKey': {
>                     'asm': spk.get('asm', ''),
>                     'hex': spk.get('hex', ''),
>                     'type': spk.get('type', ''),
>                 },
>             })
>         return {
>             'txid': t['txid'],
>             'blockhash': t.get('blockhash', ''),
>             'vin': vin,
>             'vout': vout,
>         }
>
>     def _tx_via_public(self, txid):
>         r = requests.get(PUBLIC_BLOCK_API + '/tx/' + txid, timeout=HTTP_TIMEOUT)
>         if r.status_code == 404:
>             raise NotFound('Transaction not found')
>         r.raise_for_status()
>         t = r.json()
>         vin = []
>         for inp in t.get('vin', []):
>             coinbase = inp.get('scriptsig', '') if inp.get('is_coinbase') else ''
>             vin.append({'coinbase': coinbase, 'sequence': inp.get('sequence', 0)})
>         vout = []
>         for i, out in enumerate(t.get('vout', [])):
>             vout.append({
>                 'value': out.get('value', 0) / 1e8,
>                 'n': i,
>                 'scriptPubKey': {
>                     'asm': out.get('scriptpubkey_asm', ''),
>                     'hex': out.get('scriptpubkey', ''),
>                     'type': out.get('scriptpubkey_type', ''),
>                 },
>             })
>         blockhash = (t.get('status') or {}).get('block_hash', '')
>         return {
>             'txid': t['txid'],
>             'blockhash': blockhash,
>             'vin': vin,
>             'vout': vout,
>         }
>
>     def get_transaction(self, txid):
>         net = self._probe()
>         if net is None:
>             raise NotConnected('Not connected to the Bitcoin network')
>         if net == 'rpc':
>             try:
>                 return self._tx_via_rpc(txid)
>             except ValueError:
>                 raise NotFound('Transaction not found')
>         try:
>             return self._tx_via_public(txid)
>         except NotFound:
>             raise
>         except requests.RequestException as e:
>             if getattr(e, 'response', None) and e.response.status_code == 404:
>                 raise NotFound('Transaction not found')
>             raise
>

> app = Flask(__name__)
> client = BitcoinClient()

>
> @app.route('/status')
> def status():
>     if client.is_connected():
>         return jsonify({'status': 'online'})
>     return jsonify({'error': 'Not connected to the Bitcoin network'}), 503
>
>
> @app.route('/block/<block_hash>')
> def block(block_hash):
>     try:
>         data = client.get_block(block_hash)
>         return jsonify(data)
>     except NotConnected:
>         return jsonify({'error': 'Not connected to the Bitcoin network'}), 503
>     except NotFound:
>         return jsonify({'error': 'Block not found: %s' % block_hash}), 404
>     except Exception as e:
>         return jsonify({'error': str(e)}), 500
>
>
> @app.route('/transaction/<txid>')
> def transaction(txid):
>     try:
>         data = client.get_transaction(txid)
>         return jsonify(data)
>     except NotConnected:
>         return jsonify({'error': 'Not connected to the Bitcoin network'}), 503
>     except NotFound:
>         return jsonify({'error': 'Transaction not found: %s' % txid}), 404
>     except Exception as e:
